item.text: The centralized resolver already exists in `payments/core/subscription/helpers.ts`; it has no fallback for unsupported plans, which fits the requirement to add an addon only when applicable. The current local mapping duplicates that resolver exactly, except it defaults unknown plans to Mail Plus. I’m removing that duplication and making both config builders handle an absent addon explicitly.

item.text:
Implemented the assistant upsell changes. Both paid config builders now support an optional addon and build `planIDs` consistently. Addon names come from `getScribeAddonNameByPlan`, and `SelectedPlan` plus the resolver are exported through `@proton/components/payments/core`.

The existing assistant upsell test suite passed: **9/9 tests**. `git diff --check` passed.
